# Compute most common genre per playlist.
from collections import Counter

for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counts = Counter(genres)
    # Get max count, and among those with max count, pick the one that appears first in the playlist (stable order)
    max_count = max(counts.values())
    # Find first genre in playlist order that has max_count
    most_common = None
    for g in genres:
        if counts[g] == max_count:
            most_common = g
            break
    print(pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'], '->', most_common, counts)

# Update each playlist title with the most common genre.
for pl in playlists:
    pid = pl['playlist_id']
    original_title = pl['title']
    # Recompute genre for this playlist (same as above)
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counts = Counter(genres)
    max_count = max(counts.values())
    most_common = None
    for g in genres:
        if counts[g] == max_count:
            most_common = g
            break
    new_title = f"{original_title} | {most_common}"
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token, title=new_title)
    print(pid, new_title, result)
